# Diptychon

> A fast, keyboard-first, dual-panel file manager for macOS. Two folders side by side, one keystroke to send files across, multi-level undo, native Finder tags, 1.5 MB download, native Swift, no telemetry.

Diptychon is **pre-launch**: there is no download and nothing to buy yet. The site captures launch notifications. The business model is decided — a one-time purchase, never recurring billing, and no telemetry (ADR 0006 and 0007 in the project repository). The price is not set, and this site deliberately does not name one.

Every competitor figure on this site is dated and linked to the vendor's own page. Where a vendor does not document a feature, the comparison says "not documented" rather than asserting the feature is absent. Figures were last verified against vendor pages on 2026-07-11; two items are flagged on the pages themselves as pending re-verification.

## Pages

- [Diptychon — move files at the speed of your keyboard](https://diptychon.com/): The product page: what Diptychon is, the keyboard model, the cheat-sheet, and the launch-notification form.
- [Diptychon vs Marta, ForkLift, Nimble Commander & Path Finder, Mac file managers compared](https://diptychon.com/vs): Diptychon against Marta, ForkLift 4, Nimble Commander and Path Finder on price model, footprint, undo, session restore, batch rename and remote support. Every number sourced and dated.
- [Total Commander for Mac? There isn't one — the native alternatives (2026)](https://diptychon.com/total-commander-for-mac): There is no native Total Commander for macOS. What the compatibility routes cost you, which native dual-pane managers carry which part of the workflow, and what Diptychon does not do.
- [A Marta alternative for macOS: what Marta does not do (2026)](https://diptychon.com/marta-alternative): Marta is free, native and fast. The two reasons people look elsewhere are single-developer continuity and the missing file-operation undo, an open request since 2018.
- [A lighter ForkLift alternative for Mac — if you only work locally (2026)](https://diptychon.com/forklift-alternative): ForkLift 4 is the remote powerhouse. If you only ever work locally, this is what the lighter native options give up and what they give back.
- [A Path Finder alternative without the subscription (2026)](https://diptychon.com/path-finder-alternative): Path Finder is actively maintained and has the deepest feature set, but moved to recurring pricing. The one-time-purchase alternatives, compared honestly.

## Optional
